title: Handoff & Escalations Roundtable - notes
content:
Meeting: Handoff & Escalations Roundtable
Date: 2026-03-10 10:00-11:00 PT
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Carlos, Lina, Ethan, Priya, Miguel (SRE), Tara (CS lead - partial)

Purpose / Context:
Quick sync to align Solutions Engineering + Pro Services on mid-stage handoffs where customers are starting to exercise dedicated/private deployments and we have potential operational escalations. Goal was to triage active risks and assign clear owners to unblock go-lives. This is a working doc — capture loose notes + follow-ups.

Agenda (short):
- Rapid status updates (3 mins/customer)
- Open escalations and mitigation ideas
- Handoff checklist gaps discovered in last 2 weeks
- Action items & owners

Key takeaways (TL;DR):
- Two mid-market customers (AlphaRetail, FinSight) have infra config drift causing restart loops; root cause likely KV cache mismatch + quantization artifact on Dedicated nodes. SRE and runtime eng pairing scheduled for Tue 3/16.
- One Private deployment (HealthCo) delayed by HSM cert chain issue; legal/compliance engaged, ETA for cert rotation 3/19.
- Handoff checklist missing a clear verification step for autoscaling policy on Dedicated — add a smoke test to validate target RPS and cold-start latency before cutover.

Customer updates (notes to share in customer-facing thread after cleanups):
1) AlphaRetail (mid-market, Dedicated -> scale test next week)
- Owner: Carlos
- Current status: Pre-rollout smoke tests failing intermittently. Symptoms: tokenization errors for some product SKUs; backend inference restarts under load.
- Suspected cause: model variant mismatch in routing rules + KV cache eviction mismatch after quantized model swap.
- Immediate mitigation: pin serving route to legacy quantized-1 model; disable autoscale burst to force steady-state.
- Actions: Carlos to open ENG-4112 (done) and schedule pairing session with runtime (Ethan) for 3/16. Deliverable: reproducible load script + minimal repro + heap / kv cache dump.
- Risks: if not fixed before scale test (3/18), we delay product demo to customer by 1 week.

2) FinSight (early enterprise, Private deployment in VPC)
- Owner: Lina
- Status: Sporadic high tail latency on long-history queries (>2k tokens). Stack traces show repeated attention kernel fallback on one Dedicated host.
- Suspect: degraded GPU kernel on host (driver mismatch) + older micro-quantization profile applied by infra tooling.
- Immediate steps: isolate host from pool, deploy compatible kernel build (runtime team task), run the long-history regression suite.
- Actions: Lina to coordinate with infra (Miguel) to cordon the node and run health checks; PR #542 references the kernel selector fix (link above).
- Notes: Tell customer we're doing node isolation; recommend routing to fallback region if tail latency persists.

3) HealthCo (regulated, Private air-gapped trial)
- Owner: Priya
- Status: Stalled due to HSM cert chain validation error during KeyImport step in install script.
- Details: HSM vendor rotated root CA; our install script hasn't been updated to fetch new intermediate. Legal needs vendor attestation.
- Actions: Priya to escalate to security/compliance and request vendor attestation by 3/12; expected remediation by 3/19. Temporary workaround: use customer KMS import flow (requires manual key sync).

4) BetaChat (SaaS, Hosted -> Dedicated evaluation)
- Owner: Ethan
- Status: On track. Canary passed for 15k tokens/day with steady latency. Minor telemetry gap discovered where request tagging was lost for background tasks.
- Action: Ethan to add tagging in SDK call path (internal ticket created). No customer impact for next 2 weeks.

Open escalations + proposed mitigations:
- Escalation A: restart loops on AlphaRetail after quantized model swap (Priority: High)
  - Mitigation: pin to previous model, schedule parity run. Owner: Carlos. Escalate to runtime team if parity not achieved by 3/16.
- Escalation B: HSM cert chain for HealthCo (Priority: Medium-High)
  - Mitigation: engage HSM vendor, provide legal attestation. Owner: Priya. Contingency: manual KMS import.
- Escalation C: tail latency on FinSight (Priority: High)
  - Mitigation: cordon host, deploy kernel fix. Owner: Lina + Miguel. Runtime PR referenced.

Handoff checklist gaps found (quick list):
- Missing explicit 'autoscale-config verification' step — creation of small load/run that verifies target throughput and cold-start SLOs.
- No explicit runbook step for 'quantized model swap validate KV cache parity' — add a test that compares outputs for top-n tokens on representative inputs.
- Observability: some customers aren't forwarding token-level traces from dedicated nodes to Console; need to add a checklist item and example query to verify token tracing.

Decisions made during sync:
- For AlphaRetail, we agreed to a conservative rollback to legacy model for the upcoming test window and to reattempt quantized swap behind a canary.
- For FinSight, isolation of suspect host is approved; no customer-facing message unless latency persists beyond 24 hours.

Action items (owner / due):
- Carlos: produce load-repro and schedule pairing with Ethan (runtime) by 2026-03-16. (ENG-4112)
- Lina: cordon node and run regression suite; report by 2026-03-13.
- Priya: get HSM vendor attestation + update install script docs; update legal/compliance thread by 2026-03-12.
- Ethan: patch SDK tagging path + deploy canary on BetaChat by 2026-03-17.
- Miguel (SRE): create a short runbook snippet for ‘node cordon & kernel rollback’ and add to Confluence by 2026-03-15.

Notes to self / follow-ups to add to runbook:
- Add example curl + trace-level flag to verify token-level tracing on Dedicated nodes.
- Small-scale autoscale smoke test (script stored in infra/playbooks/autoscale-smoke.sh) — need to document and link.
- Create unit test for quantized/legacy parity for top-3 tokens across 50 representative prompts.

Unresolved questions / risks to raise next week:
- Do we need a policy for forced model pinning during enterprise demos? (temp policy: allow 48h pin with approval)
- Is the new kernel selector change safe for mixed-model workloads? runtime team to confirm in pairing.

Next sync: 2026-03-17 10:00 PT (same channel) — focus: progress on AlphaRetail + FinSight pairing outcomes.

Appendix (loose notes that might be noisy):
- Customer Slack snippets: AlphaRetail asked if this could be due to different tokenizer versions — noted, include tokenizer verifier in parity script.
- Quick todo: review PR #542 for kernel fallback logic — Ethan to give thumbs by 3/13.
- Retrospective note: last month we had 3 model-swap incidents; propose adding a monthly 'model-swap playbook review' to roster.

End of notes.
